description: Death foreclosure scenario matrix — metadata for local UAT. Each scenario needs a prepared loan (see docs/dcf-sanity/PROCESS.md).

scenarios.label: All EMIs on time — future INT waived, insurance settles remainder
scenarios.loan_prep: disburse + repay all EMIs till before death cycle
scenarios.death_timing: mid-cycle or after last paid EMI

scenarios.label: Overdue PRIN/INT at death — overdue in buckets first
Death mid EMI, cycle not billed — force BILLING + partial split
scenarios.loan_prep: death before billing job on current installment

scenarios.label: Death mid EMI, cycle already billed — recovered from INT row
scenarios.loan_prep: run billing through death installment before DFC approve

scenarios.label: Customer overpaid interest — EXCESS_INCOME_INT_AMT, lower UNBLD_PRIN
Split principal — BLD_PRIN to billed GL, UNBLD_PRIN to loan GL
SHG/JLG group — child DEATH_FORECLOSURE + parent RSCH on last child (SDCP-10199)
scenarios.loan_prep: product-70 parent + 2 insured ACTIVE children; penal billed must match penal_interest_accrual_details
scenarios.note: Non-last child: parent stays ACTIVE + RSCH reschedule. Last child: parent PRIN paid (not waived). Phantom PINT rows (billed>accrued) are fixture data — run local_setup_dcf_fixture_penal_reconcile.sql

scenarios.label: Pending for FR — RE_UPLOAD, no GL
Claim Closed but wrong outstanding — batch rejects APPROVE
Death on installment due date, EMI fully paid incl. PINT — penal credit reduces outstanding
scenarios.loan_prep: disburse + repay through death-cycle EMI on due date

scenarios.label: Death on due date, EMI unpaid — no death-cycle penal/fee credit
scenarios.loan_prep: death on installment due date without repayment
scenarios.expected: death_cycle penal/fee credit = 0; outstanding includes unpaid cycle components

scenarios.label: Reporting date after death — billing sync capped at death for claim; GL split after reporting sync
scenarios.loan_prep: death mid-cycle; reporting created_on weeks later
scenarios.expected: claim outstanding matches death-date snapshot; GL BLD_PRIN uses billing through reporting before split (LAN 6005077725)
scenarios.regression: b0a3757f3 writer billing order before getUnpaidBilledPrincipal

scenarios.label: NPA correction INT row + genuine customer overpayment
scenarios.loan_prep: foreclosed-reopened loan with spurious INT due row
scenarios.note: verify extra INT not suppressed; manual QA workbook

scenarios.label: Pre-death INT waived rows — owed side uses due minus waived
scenarios.expected: outstanding not inflated by waived INT obligation
